_doc: Cửu Giang's calendar and how it maps onto the game's clock (ThuyVanCanon.calendar, travel_hours). Rows as in the other files: id, src, status.

day_scale: one bible day is 2.4 game hours, so a 30-day month is 3 survival days (WorldClock's 12 months of 3 days). The five rite days are 12 game hours more, which the 36-day survival year has no month for; the clock work decides where they sit.

months, flood_rite_days: the bible's civil year (twelve thirty-day accounting months and five unnumbered flood-rite days). Their place at the year's turn, the seasons and the sport calendar are proposals. Rain varies by region; the numbered months are administrative labels.
book_one: when the player's Book I happens (Year 0, months 1-5).

line.text: The Flood-Rite Days fall between the last month of one year and the first month of the next.
The early rains come with the first month; how much falls depends on where you stand.
Tidebreak basin matches are played in the neighbourhood locks all year, and the final at the Flood-Rite Days.
